items.title: Where Could Boeing Stock Be In Five Years?
items.summary: Our Nov 11 piece, What's Going To Happen With Boeing Stock Soon?, found that management conceded on the Oct 27 call that steadying the 737 line at 47 jets a month is taking longer than it expected. Since the Nov 10 close before that piece, the stock has slipped another 1.1%, to $171.50 at Friday's close. The next question is the long one: where could Boeing stock be in five years.

items.title: Northrop Grumman Secures New $1.6B Defense Award – Here’s What Investors Need To Know
items.summary: The $1.6 billion multi-year order covers solid rocket motors and ignition safety devices essential to Lockheed Martin's production of PAC-3 MSE interceptors.

items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks That Don’t Need a Booming Economy to Keep Paying
items.summary: A heart device maker, a bomber builder, and a garbage hauler all raised their payouts in 2020, when the economy stalled. Their yields look small, but the cash behind them tells a bigger story about what recessions can't touch.

items.title: Can DeepStrike JR3 Strengthen RTX's Precision Fires Growth?
items.summary: RTX's DeepStrike JR3 clears its third flight test, demonstrating accuracy, affordability and reusability as it targets precision-fires growth.

items.title: Amazon Just Lost 40 Leo Satellites. The Bigger Problem Is the Rocket It Booked 38 Launches On
items.summary: Forty satellites vanished in minutes, yet Wall Street barely blinked. The real damage sits in a launch schedule with few backup rockets, a 2029 regulatory clock, and a rival that happens to be one of Amazon's own launch providers.

items.title: Can RKLB's 100th Electron Launch Strengthen Its Market Position?
items.summary: Rocket Lab's record-setting 100th Electron launch highlights its growing launch activity, repeat customer demand and expansion plans despite a premium valuation.

items.title: Firefly Aerospace vs. Redwire: Which Industrials Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: Firefly's $1.4 billion backlog and Redwire's 45.8% revenue growth point to very different bets, and the valuation gap may be the deciding factor.
